Hyundai recalls over 94,600 US vehicles due to fire risk

Hyundai is recalling more than 94,600 vehicles in the United States due to a fire risk associated with the power seat motor. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) reported that the issue could lead to sparks. The recall affects Hyundai and Genesis models.
